name: W01_arrival
final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE widest landscape 3:1 concept picture, a screenshot of a BUILDABLE Roblox horror game, simple boxy geometry and modest flat matte surfaces, clean game edges and simple shadows; standing eye height wide camera. No photo, painting, film grain, haze, god rays, lens flare, UI, logos, watermarks, people or players.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 plan_v3 is spatial plan ONLY, never copy its annotations. Image 2 round-two picture is LAYOUT ONLY; discard ALL its modern finishes, wrong shop names and old barrier wording. Other images supply level/garment shapes ONLY; remove any players and unrelated text.
MANDATORY 1989-1994 tired provincial mall and Backrooms look: flat dim warm green-yellow fluorescent illumination, pervasive mono-yellow cast. Old tube troffers behind visibly yellowed PRISMATIC plastic lenses, some dead, one dim. Low 2x2 acoustic tile ceiling, off-white gone cream, occasional brown stains and sagging. FLOOR ENTIRELY MATTE worn beige/brown commercial vinyl tiles or dull terrazzo with brown border, absolutely NO reflections or shine. Near shops muted mustard/brown low-pile carpet. Yellowed cream textured plaster or faded mustard faint damask walls, brown ceramic skirting, faded teal-and-mauve stripe at hand height. Oak-effect laminate, dull brass rails/edging, smoked bronze glass, beige plastic. Restrained brown plastic tubs of artificial plants.
Signs are dated backlit plastic boxes, cream/pale yellow uneven faces, CHUNKY BOLD ROUNDED or BOLD ITALIC dark RED/BROWN/TEAL capitals; oak or dull brass borders. NO white type on black fascias, thin modern sans serif, LED strips, spotlights, bright white lighting or futuristic glowing pads. Only exact named sign/tape text may carry letters. No product text.
Every visible shop is FULLY OPEN across width, shutter entirely hidden in top box, back two thirds readable small level showcase, front third queue bay with EXACTLY THREE LOW ROUND DARK GREEN discs with pale green MATTE rings, each about two players wide. One small cream sign on beige/brass post beside EACH disc, exact text STATION 1, STATION 2, STATION 3 in chunky dark teal capitals. No luminous neon pad rings.
Whenever kiosk is visible: SMALL HEXAGON island 1990s jewellery kiosk, six waist-high counter sides with one entrance gap, oak-effect laminate fronts, dull brass kick rail and corner trim, sloping bronze-glass case tops over faded burgundy velvet. Six thin dull-brass corner posts hold LOW HEXAGON canopy with uneven cream backlit fascia, every face reads SHOP & SUPPLIES in chunky dark red. Under-canopy old fluorescent tubes, modest warm light only slightly brighter than mall. Register, stool, small plain game gadgets, shield device, potion bottles, route markers, torches, batteries, empty suits on two short rails.
Whenever barrier visible: row of waist-high black/yellow striped poles on ROUND bases, yellow TAPE across WHOLE corridor width with COMPLETE repeated black capital phrase DANGER: DO NOT GO PAST THIS POINT; absolutely NO other tape text. No fence, easy to duck under. Same mall continues into black past tape, ALL lights dead.
SCENE-SPECIFIC REQUEST: From entrance mat at standing eye height, hanging WELCOME sign and a row of trolleys, show entire concourse, open showcases on both sides, small hexagonal SHOP & SUPPLIES kiosk middle distance and barrier at end of light. Follow plan left shops 1,3,5 and right 2,4,6. Show all six exact shop signs: 1 OFFICE; 2 POOLROOMS; 3 MALL PARTY; 4 CINEMA; 5 THE VOID; 6 PLAY ZONE. CRITICAL: 2 POOLROOMS means WATER AND ROUND TILED COLUMNS WITH FLARED TOPS, matching V01 layout reference, never a pool table or billiards room. Show dark teal shallow water inside it. Absolutely no hanging spotlights or pool cues. Preserve cinema navy walls/neon bands and small screen. Floor rough MATTE vinyl, no sheen anywhere. Pad rings flat painted pale green without emitted light. Kiosk canopy clearly six-sided. TEXT CHECK: in every shop including POOLROOMS, the three station signs read left-to-right STATION 1, STATION 2, STATION 3, each number used ONCE. Do not duplicate STATION 3. Rough dry vinyl with zero specular highlights; dull brown border equally matte.
what_is_off: Third try still duplicates STATION 2 in Cinema, gives the floor border some sheen, and leaves distant station/tape lettering too small to verify fully.
